part.text:
Fixed. The crash was in `ACLLoadFromFile` (src/acl.c:2427): when a replica runs `ACL LOAD`, the client list includes the primary-link client, whose `user` is deliberately set to `NULL` (src/replication.c:2002, meaning "can do everything"). The loop unconditionally dereferenced `c->user->name`, causing a SIGSEGV on replicas only.

The fix skips clients with a NULL `user` in the ACL-reload client-disconnection loop, since their permissions are not governed by ACL rules. Verified with `unit/acl` (including the previously failing "Test ACL LOAD works on replica"), plus `acl-v2`, `networking`, `pubsub`, `pubsubshard`, `replybufsize`, `wait`, `auth`, `multi`, and `pause` — all pass.
